title: Τῶν Ἀράτου καὶ Εὐδόξου φαινομένων ἐξήγησις — Commentary on the Phaenomena of Aratus and Eudoxus; RU: «Комментарий к „Явлениям“ Арата и Евдокса»
author: Hipparchus of Nicaea
genre: Astronomy; critical commentary on didactic poetry
size: 3 books; est. c. 30,000 words (Manitius 1894: 376 pp. including facing German and notes)
edition: Manitius, Teubner 1894, Greek with German, public domain: https://archive.org/details/McGillLibrary-hssl_hipparchou-ton-aratou_QB41H561894-18575
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia «Гиппарх» (Издания и переводы) lists only Manitius 1894 and Almagest RU; ΣΧΟΛΗ translation index (Shchetnikov's astronomy series: Geminus, Cleomedes, Autolycus) has no Hipparchus.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia «Hipparchus», Translations: only German (1894) and Italian (2013/2022). Vanin–Cusinato, arXiv 2206.08243: first modern-language translation since Manitius 1894.
other_translations: German: Manitius 1894. Italian: Cusinato & Vanin 2013, 3rd ed. 2022 (open, arXiv 2206.08243).
value: Only surviving work of antiquity's greatest observational astronomer; chief evidence for Eudoxus' lost Phaenomena, the scholarly reception of Aratus and pre-Ptolemaic star positions (renewed by the 2022 Sinai palimpsest find of his catalogue). Used by historians of astronomy, Hellenistic poetry and science.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: plain technical Koine; risk lies in numbers (degrees, risings and settings). Agents must check figures against planetarium computation and against Manitius and Vanin.
pilot_unit: Book 1 (critique of Aratus and Eudoxus, reply to Attalus), est. 10–12k words
